item.title: 'Welcome competition including Starlink': Reliance reacts to Musk's comments
item.description: Reliance Industries has welcomed the entry of Elon Musk's Starlink into the Indian satellite communications market. The company clarified that it has never feared competition and is also awaiting clearances for its satellite services. Musk has alleged that Reliance benefits from monopolistic practices and has questioned regulatory barriers. The Indian government has stated that all companies must comply with existing laws and security requirements.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: 'I can always talk to you like this': On cam, IAS officer abuses woman during meeting
item.description: Kumar Rajeev Ranjan, an IAS officer, reportedly insulted a subordinate female officer during a video meeting. This incident has sparked widespread condemnation from various political parties in Jammu and Kashmir. Ranjan allegedly used derogatory language and threatened to get the officer suspended. While the labour department claimed the video is fabricated, JKAS officers assert its authenticity. Numerous calls for inquiry and action against Ranjan have been made following this incident.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: ‘Series in India brings nothing to Windies’: Cricket’s revenue model sparks debate
item.description: Cricket West Indies CEO Chris Dehring criticised the bilateral revenue model, saying the board earns nothing when the team tours India, despite series potentially generating $20–30 million. He traced the problem to a 1997 ICC decision allowing hosts to retain broadcasting revenue. Dehring blamed the system for West Indies’ financial struggles, which have led to player pay cuts and suspended domestic competitions.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: Musk’s ‘China prediction’ may add pain to world’s most valuable tech firms
item.description: A recent sell-off in AI and semiconductor stocks has resulted in a loss exceeding $1 trillion. Major technology companies are experiencing significant declines due to multiple economic pressures. Chinese chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies aims to enhance its memory chip production, potentially increasing market competition. Analysts highlight that rising inflation and interest rates contribute to the erosion of investor sentiment across the sector.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Uttarakhand minister files FIR against husband, alleges assault, plot to kill her
item.description: Uttarakhand cabinet minister Rekha Arya has taken the courageous step of filing a police report against her husband Girdhari Lal Sahu. In her allegations, she has accused him of a range of serious offenses, including physical assault, threats towards their children, infidelity, and even a conspiracy to kill her. Arya alleges that Sahu misled her about his marital status and resorted to violence when confronted about his extramarital affairs.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANI AZAD

item.title: Meet Gabriella Rothberg, 17, co-inventor of patented genetically engineered tomato
item.description: A sandwich idea at 15 led Miami student Gabriella Rothberg to develop genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, an iron-containing molecule associated with meat flavour. Now 17, she is listed alongside her father on a US patent issued in June 2026. The project remains experimental, with taste and nutritional benefits yet to be established.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Hillingdon Council urges help to ID fly-tippers as fines top £134K
item.description: Hillingdon Council in west London is urging residents to identify suspected fly-tippers through CCTV images shared on Facebook. The enforcement drive has resulted in more than 300 fixed penalty notices worth around £134,000. England recorded over 1.26 million fly-tipping incidents last year, a 9% increase, with serious offenders facing prison sentences.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr erase $550M medical debt for Californians
item.description: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel and wife Miranda Kerr are helping erase $550 million in medical debt for more than 261,000 Californians and supporting Los Angeles wildfire survivors. Spiegel recalled watching his childhood home burn during the January 2025 fires. The couple's philanthropy also includes community relief, long-term health research and encouraging their children to give back.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Michael Dell loses $20 billion in one day after Barclays downgrade
item.description: Michael Dell experienced a substantial decline in net worth, dropping more than $20 billion in just one day. This decline was prompted by a major decrease in his company's stock value following an analyst downgrade. Earlier this year, Dell's net worth had notably increased, bringing him closer to the highest billionaires in the world.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Ludhiana teen wins Eco-Hero award for pollinator gardens
item.description: Gunisha Kaur, a 16-year-old from Ludhiana, creates pollinator gardens to support biodiversity and inclusion. Her initiative, Buzzing Blooms, transforms urban spaces into chemical-free habitats for both pollinators and children. Over 24 months, the project recorded significant increases in pollinator species and bee visitation. Engaging local communities, Buzzing Blooms focuses on inclusive outdoor spaces catering to diverse needs. Through workshops and advocacy, Kaur aims to foster environmental action among youth.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Two Syrian pipelines damaged in fresh blow to war-hit energy network
item.description: Two pipelines transporting gas and petroleum products in Syria experienced damage due to separate incidents. An explosion occurred on the Jbessa gas pipeline, igniting a fire that required emergency response. Meanwhile, a leak occurred on the Baniyas-Homs pipeline, believed to be linked to attempted fuel theft. The Syrian Petroleum Company is working to repair the damaged sections and maintain gas supplies.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: France protests flare as PM accuses radical left of exploiting unrest ahead of elections
item.description: Student protests are sweeping across France as frustrations rise over overcrowded classrooms and poor school facilities. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu accuses the La France Insoumise party of taking advantage of the situation for political gain. With thousands joined by trade unions and parents, their calls for educational equity harken back to the 1968 student uprising, demanding reforms such as wealth taxes and a voting age reduction to 16.

item.title: ‘Too old’ to Asian Games MMA medallist: Suchika Tariyal’s journey from judo to glory
item.description: At 36, after years of setbacks, selection hurdles and changing sports, Suchika Tariyal finally has the Asian Games medal she had chased since childhood. India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist came within 700 grams of a place in the final at Aichi-Nagoya. From an eight-time national judo champion to a ju-jitsu world champion, Tariyal’s journey has been shaped by financial strain, doubts over her age and her husband Kapil Hooda’s unwavering faith.

item.title: Para-shuttlers challenge Para Asian Games non-selection in Delhi HC
item.description: Chirag Baretha, a decorated para-badminton player, and fellow para-shuttlers have filed a petition after being excluded from India’s 2026 Asian Para Games contingent despite meeting the selection criteria. Alleging unfair treatment and procedural irregularities, they have challenged the roles of the Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Badminton Association of India (BAI), raising questions about transparency in the selection process.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: 10-year-old girl throws 18-month-old toddler off 6th floor of Mumbai building
item.description: Mumbai police are investigating the tragic death of an 18-month-old girl in a Goregaon housing society. CCTV footage revealed a 10-year-old girl throwing the toddler down the stairwell from the sixth floor. The toddler was playing outside when her mother sent a brother to find her, leading to the grim discovery. Residents rushed the injured child to a doctor, but she was pronounced dead shortly after.
item.dc:creator: NITASHA NATU

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Qazi recalls saying no to Ekta Kapoor rockstar show; slams media scrutiny
item.description: After winning Fame Gurukul, Qazi Touqeer found himself at a crossroads as he received multiple offers. However, he declined a prominent role from Ekta Kapoor, which sparked misunderstandings. Under pressure while discussing the opportunity, he soon faced backlash from the media, who branded him arrogant for his choice, despite having already committed to a film project.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Imran Khan was just passing through, didn’t take part in Mumbai protests: Lawyers
item.description: Imran Khan has been asked by the FRRO to leave India by October 28, raising legal concerns. Lawyers argue that he did not participate in the protest and only passed through the area. The police have charged the protestors for illegal assembly due to lacking permission for the demonstration. Legal representatives plan to seek CCTV footage to support Khan's claims regarding his involvement.
item.dc:creator: AHMED ALI

item.title: 'Reel ke chakkar mein thuk jaoge': Sooryavanshi warns paps - Watch
item.description: Teenage cricket star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi went viral after jokingly warning airport paparazzi, “Reel ke chakkar mein thuk jaoge,” urging them to prioritise safety over filming. He was in New Delhi to meet PM Narendra Modi during a felicitation ceremony for India’s Asian Games contingent. Modi encouraged athletes to inspire children, highlighting sports’ role in teaching discipline, resilience and perseverance through his message, “Jo Khelega, Woh Khilega.”
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: Zelenskyy’s worst nightmare is here: Ukraine runs out of Patriot missiles
item.description: Ukraine's shortage of Patriot air defence missiles has left it exposed to Russian missile attacks and critical infrastructure damage. Recent attacks have targeted power plants in Kyiv and Kharkiv, resulting in casualties. Relations between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and the US government have soured amid disputes over energy and military support. Additionally, limitations on Starlink connectivity have disrupted military operations in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Oil prices dip marginally as US weighs easing sanctions on ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
item.description: Amid fluctuating oil markets, current tensions in the Middle East and possible shifts in US sanctions have resulted in a marginal decline in oil prices. WTI crude is priced at $97.31, with Brent crude at $105.40. While recent moves to lift restrictions on certain vessels aim to counter soaring global freight rates, the International Energy Agency's diesel release hasn't completely eased concerns about oil supply.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Absconding in UP bizman murder case, accused model Shraddha Dubey may be in Nepal
item.description: The investigation into Shiva Sharma's death has led authorities to search for Shraddha Dubey across borders. CCTV footage reportedly shows Shraddha, her sister Rashmi, and an associate Adil in Nepal. They are believed to have fled Lucknow soon after the incident, raising suspicion. Sharma's family has alleged foul play, while Dubey maintains her innocence and claims he died by suicide.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY

item.title: ‘Lacks common sense’: Ashwin blasts India over Kuldeep’s exclusion
item.description: Former India spinner R Ashwin criticised the team management for dropping Kuldeep Yadav from the last two T20Is against the West Indies, saying the decision “lacks a bit of common sense.” Ashwin argued Kuldeep’s variations troubled the visiting batters and could have saved India 15–20 runs. However, he supported Kuldeep’s exclusion in Indore due to the ground’s small dimensions.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection: Rajinikanth's film earns Rs 59.70cr net in India
item.description: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' was released on October 15 and generated impressive opening day earnings. The film collected Rs 59.70 cr net in India and Rs 70.25 cr gross from local shows. Its overall worldwide gross reached Rs 125.25 cr, including Rs 55 cr from international markets. The Tamil version of 'Jailer 2' contributed significantly to the box office performance with high occupancy rates.

item.title: "I only drink on weekends": Can occasional drinking still damage the liver even without any symptoms?
item.description: Regular weekend drinking might feel harmless, but it can severely compromise your liver health. The liver, tasked with processing alcohol, may incur cellular damage and cause inflammation over time. Persistent episodes of binge drinking can lead to conditions like fatty liver disease, which often shows no symptoms. Without attention, this damage could escalate to fibrosis or cirrhosis, impairing liver function and overall well-being.
item.dc:creator: AADYA JHA

item.title: Maya Angelou: When people show you who they are, believe them the first time
item.description: Maya Angelou's wisdom teaches us to pay attention to actions that unveil true character within relationships. Oprah Winfrey underscores the need to view consistent behavior as significant rather than waving them off as simple mistakes. A relationship thrives on accountability, fostering awareness of recurring patterns. Although trust and forgiveness are vital components, they should never excuse ongoing disrespect or lack of integrity.
item.dc:creator: TIMESOFINDIA.COM

item.title: Brittany Mahomes takes major step to boost women's soccer in Kansas City
item.description: Brittany Mahomes is helping the Kansas City Current attract 18,000 fans for its October 25 match against the Washington Spirit, aiming to grow women's soccer in Kansas City. Meanwhile, Patrick Mahomes is using the Chiefs' early bye week to rest his injured knee before facing the Chargers on October 18. The quarterback has recorded 1,037 passing yards and nine touchdowns in four games this season, helping Kansas City remain unbeaten.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office: India collection stands at Rs 338.98 cr
item.description: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' has earned Rs 338.98 crore in India as of its 70th day in theaters. The film's overseas gross has reached Rs 48.30 crore, contributing to a global total of Rs 448.33 crore. However, Thursday's net earnings declined significantly compared to the previous day. The Hindi and Telugu versions of the movie recorded varying occupancy rates across different shows.

item.title: US temple attack plot: Teen’s alleged manifesto describes Indians as ‘subhumans’
item.description: A 19-year-old white supremacist's intention to attack a temple near Chicago was disrupted by a rifle malfunction. Following the incident, concerned colleagues notified authorities after he expressed his intentions via messages. Police arrested Alexandros Paporakis, uncovering alarming materials including a manifesto that targeted several communities. The case has raised serious safety concerns among Hindu organizations about worship places.
